waypoints.name: NF-110 gravel pull-off (Infinite Bliss / Southwest Ledges parking)
waypoints.directions: From I-90 Exit 34, go north on 468th Ave SE about 0.4 mile and turn right onto SE Middle Fork Road (FR 56). Drive about 12.3 miles to the fork just past the Taylor River bridge, keep right on the Middle Fork Road, and continue about 1 mile to a small gravel pullout with room for about five cars, at roughly 1,170 ft. Washouts on this road have at times added a mile or more of walking.

waypoints.name: Base of Infinite Bliss — leave the climber's path here and head up into the forest
waypoints.directions: Walk 100 to 200 yards farther along the road and take the unsigned but well-worn Infinite Bliss climbers' path leaving on the left at a cairn. It climbs steeply through forest switchbacks for 30 to 45 minutes; leave it just before it turns left to the base of the bolted slab.
